case.query: Synthetic workflow demo only: exercise cfDNA ctDNA MRD source-tracing retrieval for a caller signal; surface CHIP, matched WBC, assay LOD, serial and longitudinal context, artifacts, uncertainty, and source-trace checks. Do not make a clinical inference.

missing_information_checklist.reason: Matched WBC/buffy coat status is needed to downgrade CHIP/hematopoietic origin.
Tumor tissue confirmation helps separate tumor-derived MRD from plasma-only noise.
Sampling timepoint is needed to evaluate postoperative or post-treatment cfDNA perturbation.
VAF or molecular burden is needed for LOD, low-level signal, and longitudinal trend review.
Assay type is needed for tumor-informed/tumor-naive and LOD interpretation.
Cancer stage is needed for MRD-guided management evidence and false-negative risk.
Treatment setting is needed before discussing escalation, de-escalation, or surveillance.
